findings.problem: Line 5 says David "stands on God's side, against the ones who rise against Him (Ps 139:21-22)." The text calls it hate: "Do I not hate those who hate You" and "I hate them with perfect hatred; I count them as my enemies" (Psalm 139:21-22). "Stands against" renames what David says. The line also skips Psalm 139:19-20, where David asks God to slay the wicked and calls them bloodthirsty men and God's enemies who take His name in vain.

rule.text: Call things what the text calls them.

findings.problem: Line 6 joke: "in my crooked years I slid to the back of the drawer, behind the takeout menus. David pulls out the WHOLE drawer and dumps it on the counter." It puts David inside Papa Dorin's drawer image, blending the comparison with the Bible scene. The actions also don't match: Papa Dorin was set aside by the family, while David asks God to search him (Psalm 139:23).

rule.text: One image only. Never blend the comparison with the Bible setting.
